item.title: The 8-Hour Wedding Photography Timeline That Actually Works
item.description: A minute-by-minute sample timeline for eight hours of wedding photography, with and without a first look, plus how to move it for a 4 PM or 6 PM ceremony and where couples always run late.

item.description: Eight Austin wedding venues couples ask us about, from Dripping Springs to downtown, with Google ratings, the ceremony start time for every month of 2027, and how to handle the heat in July and the dark in December.
